{{Quote|Je'daii must know their limits. There are places we should not go, things we should not do, powers we should not seek. The Force has an incredible strength, but a Je'daii's true strength is in knowing when to use it, and when not.|Shall Mar, 7,541 TYA|<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''28,912 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''7,541 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, [[Je'daii Master]] [[Shall Mar]] was in the process of writing ''[[A Life in Balance]]'', and he philosophized on a [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii's]] need to heed their limits and understand when to use and when not to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="DOTJ" />
